[NDBG.12.5.2] `key` is the cache key string. Empty string matches
any key. `on` is a non-empty list of `"get"`, `"set"` and `"delete"`.
`"delete"` covers a TTL expiry as well as the delete verb ([NSTG.2.4.3]).

In replay, a `"get"` breakpoint is `verified: false` with message `"a trace
does not record cache reads"`; its `"set"` and `"delete"` stand.
